name: Spinach

schedule.notes: As early as you can work the soil.
Cut outer leaves at 4 in; or harvest whole at first bolt sign.
Fall crop is sweeter. Mulch heavily for overwintering in zones 6+.

harvest.cues: Leaves are 3 to 5 in, dark green, before flower stalk appears.
harvest.storageNotes: Wrap loosely in paper towel, refrigerate. Use within a week.

varieties.name: Bloomsdale Long Standing
varieties.notes: Crinkled leaves, classic flavor, slower to bolt.

varieties.name: Space
varieties.notes: Smooth flat leaves, easier to clean. Tolerates more heat.

notes: Bolts hard above 75 F and long days. Choose bolt-resistant cultivars for spring; standard types are fine for fall.
